summary: Campus secondhand marketplace (SRM Institute) with professional UI, product listings, filtering, authentication, and navigation. Currently implementing Chunk 2 premium features in phases.
architectural_notes: Chutes LLM integration via environment variables (CHUTES_API_KEY, CHUTES_BASE_URL, CHUTES_COMPLETIONS_PATH, CHUTES_MODEL, CHUTES_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
Email verification pattern: exactly 2 letters + 4 digits @srmist.edu.in
Chunk-based development strategy to manage build complexity and credit limits
Analytics dashboard with CSV export capability
Dark/light theme toggle for user preferences
known_issues: Initial full Chunk 2 build failed - splitting into smaller combined chunks to avoid build errors

existing_features.title: Create an analytics dashboard page at /insights displaying sales trends, view counts, and engagement metrics with interactive charts for time ranges (7, 30, 90 days)
Add CSV export functionality to the analytics dashboard allowing users to download their analytics data
Implement dark/light theme toggle with persistence, applying the theme consistently across all pages and components
Implement a review and rating system where buyers can rate sellers after transactions, and display seller reputation scores on listing pages and profiles
Add favoriting functionality allowing users to save listings to a favorites collection with optimistic UI updates
Create a comparison tool that allows users to select up to 3 listings and view them side-by-side in a comparison view showing price, condition, features, and seller ratings
Implement a recently viewed tracker that records listings users have viewed and displays them in a horizontal strip on the home page and a dedicated page

new_feature_requests.summary: Analytics dashboard with charts (sales trends, views, engagement) and CSV export
Advanced sorting (relevance, price, newest, popularity, condition, distance)
Review/rating system with seller reputation scores
Favoriting and comparison tools (up to 3 listings)
AI features (description generator, recommendations, semantic search) with Chutes LLM integration
Academic calendar integration (manual admin config + automatic alerts)
Student verification badges with email pattern validation (xx####@srmist.edu.in)
Original price tracking and depreciation calculator
Bulk listing tools for move-out sales
Add advanced sorting options for listings: relevance, price (low to high, high to low), newest first, popularity, condition quality, and distance from user
Create featured/spotlight sections on the home page and search results that display promoted listings with distinct visual styling
